## Construction and direct parent application

All new names have prefix `YulangClosure.PerCallResidualPublicationR52.`. `Captured` retains one R51 `ForwardProbe`, exclusive origin/emission ends, completion Option with cut/end/index, pre-call exact-slot bound, exact new slot-emission indices and prior count. `Store.keyed` selects by `(publication, original planIndex)` before endpoint comparison; `Installed` requires `Store.identified` to return the SAME record. `project` constructs R51's call, receipt, completion and per-call snapshot tables directly from these records while retaining the base native state, source facts, physical candidates and frame.

`key_unique`, `identity_unique`, `distinct_keys_no_alias`, `call_identity_fixes_index` prove lookup/index nonaliasing. `Window` is half-open: lower cut inclusive, end exclusive. `origin_separation`, `completion_separation`, `emission_separation`, `earlier_rejected`, `later_rejected`, `lower_cut_inclusive`, `upper_cut_exclusive` expose ordered-call separation. `later_emission_source_rejected` rejects a later neighbor at the source-mode premise itself.

`captured_instantiates_r51` universally quantifies the unchanged Artifact/Id/Term/Fact types, base, store, query, index, endpoint and ONE captured record. Its explicit source premises are `Installed`, `CallSource` (exact original upper/fact/occurrence/slot/cause/return), `DrainSource` (full exact origin/receipt/completion, windows, native relations/task) and `ModeSource` (native pre/current physical reads and new ancestry, or AlreadyPresent with no new emission). It constructs the SAME record's R51 `CallReads ∧ DrainReads ∧ ModeReads`; no target predicate is simply assumed. These source-premise definitions do not supply real Rust instances.

`captured_forward_native` applies this result immediately to R51 `ForwardReads` and `forward_current_native` using explicit native candidate/slot/bound/polarity/lane reads. `concrete_source_premises` actually constructs finite premises, and `concrete_parent_application` applies the generic bridge to them. `concrete_repeated_publication` checks a complete R51 observation with original list `[7,8,7]`: calls 0 and 2 have equal endpoint/task/occurrence/cause but distinct identities/indices/origin/completion segments; the second equal call is AlreadyPresent. Swapping those equal calls or borrowing the earlier drain rejects. `concrete_same_record_bridge` includes AlreadyPresent with ZERO old emissions and no fabricated physical emission.

`captured_missing_completion_unavailable`, `unavailable_observer_successful_forward`, `concrete_completion_gap_keeps_call`, and `concrete_observer_loss_preserves_return` separate returned Forward fields from observer availability. Missing completion can preserve an authenticated call while making observation false. These are finite model statements, never runtime or allocation-failure receipts. Concrete cut attacks cover old origin/completion, later emission/completion, both exact boundaries and +1 cut errors; wrong publication and swapped indices reject.

First remaining premise/owner at R51's source-correspondence gap: the Rust lane/primary must give a total faithful extraction for each successful retained publication, constructing `Installed`, `CallSource`, `DrainSource`, `ModeSource` and native/whole-publication frame/fact/plan reads from ONE live State and SAME original source context. Same-state lifetime, canonical endpoints/brands, fact/occurrence joins, complete inventories, cut monotonicity and actual native execution remain source premises. Once supplied for all original items, R51 `accepted_forward_native`, `original_unmatched_survives_native`, `accepted_exact_native_frame` and R50 suppression lemmas apply with the SAME query/witness.
